'''Gabriel Alonso''' won the [[1997 Endor Regionals (Seattle)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm 26 years-old, and have just been playing Star Wars CCG for a few months, though I've played Magic at a competitive level for several years. I recently became a father for the first time. My wife and I are the proud parents of an incredibly healthy baby girl."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/alonso.html Gabriel Alonso], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427132405/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/alonso.html Internet Archive]</ref>
